camera.label: Camera

help.views: Camera angle: default, above, front, side

follow: Camera follows new births while playing

noGL.title: 3D is not available here
noGL.body: This browser or device can't run WebGL, which the 3D studio needs. The 2D tree shows the same family.

weak.title: This device may struggle with 3D
weak.body: Your device seems to have no graphics acceleration, so the 3D studio may be slow. The 2D tree shows the same family and is smoother.

slow: 3D is running slowly on this device. The 2D tree will be smoother.
empty: Add people to this family to see it in 3D.
